instructions: This file declares WHERE things live inside Hedge's public feeds — it is
the only place feed field names are written down. It ships UNCONFIRMED
because the build environment cannot reach hedgespecialty.com.
Ops pass: run `python tools/fetch_hedge_feeds.py`, open the captured
files in hedge/fixtures/, copy the real field names in here, and flip
confirmed to true. Until then the UI renders feeds verbatim-raw with a
text filter (still correct, just less tailored) and the adapter returns
entries_path: dotted path to the list of entries ('' if the document
root is already the list). *_key: field name inside one entry.
